notes.title: VetVR Update 2/27/2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
VetVR has a new update for you all to check out. To celebrate VetVR will go on a 20% sale for a week starting on 2/28. We thank you all for your patience as we worked on this update.

New Scenarios:
	- Anesthesia Machine Setup
	- Bain System
	- Circle System
	- Alaska Scenario

Changes:
	- Vital Monitor has been completely reworked. If it went well you shouldn't notice much differences but there may be bugs we are unaware of. Please let us know if you find any
	- Phone can be activated with the grip to give a hint (previously only could be while using the ray)
	- New projector model for tutorials
	- Drug UI now displays how drugs affect the vitals of the dog
	- A new friend is in the lobby
	- IV system updated to use a simpler version

Notes:
	- The first three scenarios listed are tutorials for the exam for those who were interested in taking it.
	- For our next update, we plan on adding more scenarios involving taking care of dogs with already taught aspects and less tutorials.
	
We will be going back to work on more scenarios. The next update should hopefully come out much sooner than this one. Going forward the updates will most likely focus on 1-2 scenarios rather than how big this one ended up being. We hope to have some news for you soon!

notes.title: Update Notes for April 28th, 2023
notes.content:
Changes:
	- "Vet in Training" added, all other difficulty names moved to account for this
	- Medication Calculator will now show a log of currently administered medicine
	- There was an inconsistency in objects highlighting when hovered over, we decided to remove the highlighting
	- phone now uses 3d sound
	- Maya and Mooncake scenarios should now alert you if you don't properly dispose of splinter/quills (level requires splinter/quill to be put in trash tray)
	- Stethoscope Level now more clear and should be more responsive
	- Should be notified when new levels are unlocked
	- Mooncake and Maya scenarios have slight changes to using the tweezers to hopefully be more accurate
	- Skip all added to dialogue
	- clicking in the left thumbstick allows you to arc teleport
	- Wrist UI is larger (to help legibility)
	- Removed innacurate labels in Atlas Scenario
	- Bonuses now have hints in patient info
	- Ultrasound win condition triggers better

Bug fixes:
	- heart rate and pulse should be available on every level
	- various wording fixes/changes in text
	- Bruce should go through full petting animation
	- Bruce monitor and capnograph no longer having issues
	- All levels with Medication should properly play the medication administering sound
	- If you close the wrist menu while the blood related information is loading it will fill the image instead of staying cut off
	- Mooncake Scenario has stethoscope
	- Patient info and drug calculation won't display wrong info if you move the clipboard
	- Ring Toy has collision noises
	- Listening to a heartbeat no longer has a preemptive "good work"
	- You can go back to the heartbeat slide after going to the lung slide in the Stethoscope Tutorial
	- Capnography level won't uncomplete after closing the game (will require you to rebeat it)
	- Removed softlock with Ultrasound Level
	- Blue Tubes that start connected should properly work now

Notes:
	- We are aware and looking into why sometimes the Maya level incorrectly tells you that a step was skipped. I believe this should be working much better now but let us know if you are still experiencing this issue.
	- New level notifications are going to activate each time you enter the lobby until you are caught up, this is not a bug.
	- Next major update is coming and will have more scenarios

notes.title: Patch 01 - Changes, Fixes, & Content Sneak Peak!
notes.content:
Hi Veterinarians!

We're about to release our first (official) patch. We've been working hard on many quality-of-play updates! We also have some major content updates on the horizon. Take a look at the end of our post for a sneak peak of an upcoming scenario.


[b]Changes:[/b]
	[list]
[*] "Vet in Training" added, all other difficulty names moved to account for this
[*] Medication Calculator will now show a log of currently administered medicine
[*] There was an inconsistency in objects highlighting when hovered over, we decided to remove the highlighting
[*] Phone now uses 3D sound
[*] Maya and Mooncake scenarios should now alert you if you don't properly dispose of splinter/quills (level requires splinter/quill to be put in trash tray)
[*] Stethoscope Level now more clear and should be more responsive
[*] Should be notified when new levels are unlocked
[*] Mooncake and Maya scenarios have slight changes to using the tweezers to hopefully be more accurate
[*] 'Skip all' added to dialogue
[*] Clicking in the thumbstick allows you to arc teleport
[*] Wrist UI is larger (to help legibility)
[*] Removed inaccurate labels in Atlas Scenario
[*] Bonuses now have hints in 'patient info'
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Heart rate and pulse should be available on every level
[*] Various wording fixes/changes in text
[*] Bruce should go through full petting animation
[*] Bruce monitor and capnograph no longer having issues
[*] All levels with Medication should properly play the medication administering sound
[*] If you close the wrist menu while the blood related information is loading it will fill the image instead of staying cut off
[*] Mooncake Scenario has stethoscope
[*] Patient info and drug calculation won't display wrong info if you move the clipboard
[*] Ring Toy has collision noises
[*] Listening to a heartbeat no longer has a preemptive "good work"
[*] You can go back to the heartbeat slide after going to the lung slide in the Stethoscope Tutorial
[*] Capnography level won't uncomplete after closing the game (will require you to re-beat it)
[/list]

[b][i]Notes:[/i][/b]
[i]
*We are aware and looking into why sometimes the Maya level incorrectly tells you that a step was skipped. I believe this should be working much better now but let us know if you are still experiencing this issue. TY! 
*Next major update is coming and will have new fun scenarios! :) 
[/i]

Thanks again to everyone who has been giving us amazing feedback on our community page and through socials. We love hearing from you! As always, let us know what you think, what you'd like different, and what future animal patients/treatment scenarios you would like to see.

[b]Wishlist[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210500/VetVR_Veterinary_Simulator/]VetVR Veterinary Simulator[/url]

Thanks for the continued support!

Sincerely,
Bruce and the Gang

notes.title: VetVR Early Access Release!!
notes.content:
Hello Veterinarians!

We have been working really hard and have great news: We released our Early Access Game this week and it’s on sale until March 12, 2023! Thank you for your patience and feedback. We are excited to be part of the VR and simulation gaming worlds. Join us in a realistic veterinary training VR simulation - come meet Bruce and the Gang!

This early access release has 14 levels, and we will be adding around 21 new levels over the next year and a half. The current version is a solidly playable game, with around 2 hours of straight VR playthrough, and an open sandbox lobby with which to explore immersive, interactive VR in a veterinary setting. We hope to add around three new levels every two months (incorporating players feedback), which puts the final release around Summer 2024. 


While we have some of the next levels/scenarios already in development, both simulation game development and VR training are new-ish and we're excited to keep learning what our players want. Our Steam community has been great and we look forward to continuing the conversation, answering questions, and hearing more of your amazing suggestions. Reach out and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Introducing VetVR Veterinary Simulator - Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
Happy 2023, Veterinarians! 

We are Liekos Studio, the indie team behind [i]VetVR Veterinary Simulator[/i], a reality based veterinary simulator about saving animal lives, diagnosing mysterious illnesses, and learning real life veterinary fundamentals. We are excited to announce that our demo is live! Here are just [b]some[/b] of the things available in the demo: 

[list]
[*] Game Tutorial. Learn the game mechanics ahead of our NextFest Demo! 
[*] Six unique medical scenarios, including treating a laceration and treating a pup who had an unfortunate encounter with a porcupine.
[*] Unlocked Lobby Interactions! Explore some of our favorite lobby games and interactions without having to unlock them. Get a taste of what you'll be working towards in the real game.
[*] Explore what it's like to start your career as a veterinarian!
[/list]

Want to know what else there is? Play the demo today and let us know what you think! This game is still in active development so feedback and feature requests will help us build your dream game. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/176ff28125dfb1400e17b7be07b3f55ba08bb586.png[/img]
You got hired straight out of vet school. Your new employer recognized your talent and love for animals, so they've chosen you to help them launch their brand-new vet clinic! Show them everything you’ve learned by providing gold star care to a variety of tailed and scaled clients. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/0f467294b2a2eb177cbc8f25a1e7da20cc44a9e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/643af7475097f8f997cb1e5f545b1572a6ebde57.gif[/img]
Diagnose and treat complex medical conditions, mysterious injuries, and emergency scenarios! Determine what is wrong with your patient based on the animal’s behavior, medical reports, and real-world data such as x-rays and blood tests. Find the right treatments and remember that each decision will positively or negatively impact your patient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/88a0148aa5ab904fb005ff5d109840919c5a94a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/58508534a33cc6a90dfc1d9d74b227eead1f448a.gif[/img]
Brush up on all your veterinary fundamentals by playing through numerous training levels created by real-life DVM, MSc, PhD Veterinarians ([b]visit LiekosStudio.com to learn more[/b]). Grow your confidence as a veterinarian regardless of previous knowledge levels and practice making split-second decisions that affect the life or death of your animal patient. Practice using tools, requesting tests, reading charts, and administering drugs to treat and heal animals in various levels of need. Each patient will require real veterinary logic and test your skills. When mistakes are made, rest easy knowing you can restart a scenario at any time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/2baa0c8a2ee5ba266968a828c54d64b93234da04.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/a372bd5962bd0ea10327ea22b42f6d23a28366be.gif[/img]
As you successfully complete both high and low-intensity scenarios, don’t forget to look around. You might be surprised by what you find. Discover fun Easter eggs, unlock hidden games, and be rewarded with new and exotic animal cases. Between saving lives, take some time to relax in the lobby and play fetch with the clinic mascot, Bruce. Be careful letting him around the snack bar though, he has a reputation for stealing anything with a carb in it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/0a812a68bf567ccfdce610ca4ea3b3a2f8c21334.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252377/1d258f4eb6528f55cd9cde2c76c9b89db00e96e2.gif[/img]
As you successfully treat everything from minor wounds to unidentified patient illnesses, you will find that your work is really having an impact. Customers are talking about the clinic and even recommending it to others. They’re especially fond of your care for their pets and it seems like the harder you work, the more your clinic’s reputation grows. Get rewarded by unlocking new and exciting scenarios! Did someone say the local zoo was looking for more vets in the area to work with? I guess we’ll find out.
